description: This source file defines an abstract class 'TableWithData' that extends 'Table', providing data management and UI interaction methods for table-like components within the 'com.romraider' project. It handles data setting, interpolation, selection, sizing, editing permissions, drawing, file saving, and populating table data from byte arrays.

classes.name: TableWithData
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'Table' that manages tabular data with capabilities like interpolation, selection, resizing, editing, drawing, saving, and populating from byte arrays. It supports user access control based on user levels.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data array for the table.

methods.name: getDataCell
methods.description: Retrieves a specific DataCell based on its position.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs horizontal interpolation between selected data points.

methods.name: selectCellAt
methods.description: Selects a cell at a specific row index, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the dimension size of the table component.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments values of selected cells by a specified amount, respecting user level permissions.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies selected cell values by a factor, respecting user level permissions.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a KeyListener to the table and its data cells.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Draws the visual representation of each data cell.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the data into a byte array for saving, with permission checks.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates data cells from an input byte array, considering storage type and offsets.
